title: Exploring Photographs, Lesson 3: Methods of Visual Analysis
evidence_scope: Separates description, reflection, and formal analysis and supplies looking questions.
limitations: A teaching lesson, not a validated universal scoring model.

title: 2026 Contest judging process
evidence_scope: States current contest stages, criteria, and progressive introduction of context.
limitations: Applies primarily to photojournalism and documentary competition judging.

title: 2026 Contest code of ethics
evidence_scope: Defines ethical expectations for documentary and photojournalistic entries.
limitations: A contextual gate for relevant uses, not an aesthetic score for every photograph.

title: 2026 Contest verification process
evidence_scope: Documents manipulation review, original-file checks, fact checking, and disclosure requirements.
limitations: Contest-specific rules; do not impose them on disclosed conceptual or commercial work.

title: Aperture On Sight: Teaching Visual Literacy through Photography
evidence_scope: A full curriculum connecting close looking, image reading, storytelling, and photobook making.
limitations: Educational prompts require adaptation before use as critique rules.

title: Joel Meyerowitz: Seeing Things
evidence_scope: Official description confirms thirty photographs with short commentaries on light, gesture, composition, story, layers, and fleeting moments.
limitations: The full commentaries are not available on the product page; do not infer their content.

title: The Photographer's Eye
author_org: Museum of Modern Art / John Szarkowski
evidence_scope: Official MoMA publication announcement documents the book's critical perspective on photographic seeing.
limitations: This record is the announcement rather than a complete digitized book; verify chapter-level claims elsewhere.

title: Wear Good Shoes: Advice from Magnum Photographers
evidence_scope: First-party collection of short advice from Magnum photographers.
limitations: Short quotations are prompts, not evidence for universal visual rules.

title: Susan Meiselas on Building Relationships With Subjects
evidence_scope: First-party practice discussion centered on relationships with photographed people.
limitations: Practice insight from one photographer; do not turn it into a mandatory street-photography style.

title: Creative Documentary and Photojournalism Program
evidence_scope: Official program description documents assignments, feedback, critique, editing, sequencing, and exhibition work.
limitations: A high-cost professional program description, not proof of learning outcomes or a beginner recommendation.

title: Alec Soth: Cleansing the Visual Palate
evidence_scope: First-party interview material on responding to rooms, windows, light, surfaces, and people without forcing a grand narrative.
limitations: Article contains multiple works; cite an exact named image and position when used as a reference.

title: Education at Aperture
evidence_scope: Official hub for Aperture's visual literacy and photography education resources.
limitations: A hub, not a direct source for a specific critique claim.

title: 艾伦沙勒讲解：8张照片构图技巧
author_org: 光尘记 / original creator Alan Schaller
evidence_scope: Chinese translation/voiceover of an Alan Schaller lesson using eight photographs.
limitations: Uploader states the video belongs to the original creator; trace claims and images to Alan Schaller before promotion into a rule card.

title: 学习构图的底层方法论（从零学摄影07期）
evidence_scope: A popular Chinese-language course episode explicitly challenging recipe-only composition learning.
limitations: Popularity is discovery evidence only; claims, examples, and exercises still require source-by-source review.

title: Tatiana Hopper: Photography & Filmmaking
evidence_scope: Creator's official index of educational photography videos.
limitations: Use individual videos only after checking sources, exact works, and whether analysis supports the diagnosed problem.

title: The Photographic Eye / TPE Tribe
evidence_scope: Official description of a feedback-centered photography education community and the educator's background.
limitations: Self-description and testimonials do not establish critique accuracy or independent learning outcomes.

title: Reading Visual Images
evidence_scope: Eight-hour introductory course on analyzing photographs as social data, including context, documentary evidence, truth, uncertainty, and cultural diversity.
limitations: Social-science interpretation course rather than a camera-craft or image-editing curriculum.

title: Community Photo Stories
evidence_scope: Official lesson asks students to photograph their communities from varied viewpoints and connect compositional choices with narrative perspective.
limitations: Designed for grades 6–12; adapt prompts rather than assuming adult or advanced critique depth.

title: Focus on Photography: A Curriculum Guide
evidence_scope: ICP curriculum guide links photographic history, technique, aesthetics, practice, visual literacy, and how images communicate meaning.
limitations: School-oriented curriculum; individual exercises require page-level review before direct reuse.

title: The Evolution of the Book: Introducing Students to Visual Analysis
evidence_scope: Official primary-source lesson includes close description and discussion of perspective in an Ansel Adams photograph.
limitations: Broader visual-literacy lesson rather than a comprehensive photography curriculum.

title: Larry Fink on Composition and Improvisation: Learning Guide
evidence_scope: Official guide organizes Fink's first-person teaching into discussion topics, named images, vocabulary, and assignments about layered social scenes, rhythm, conflict, harmony, and chance.
limitations: Guide excerpts and interprets a paid book; inspect the cited image and page before attributing a specific claim.

title: Todd Hido on Landscapes, Interiors, and the Nude: Learning Guide
evidence_scope: Official guide structures Hido's practice around landscape, interiors, available light, subtle narrative detail, accident, and coincidence.
limitations: A single photographer's atmospheric practice; do not universalize deliberate ambiguity or night treatment.

title: This Equals That: Learning Guide
evidence_scope: Official learning guide uses paired photographs and vocabulary to teach association, framing, abstraction, focus, space, balance, and sequencing.
limitations: Designed around a children's picture book; useful for relation and sequence exercises, not as an advanced critique authority.

title: Making the Image: Mother and Child
evidence_scope: Official agency article uses a contact sheet and exact final image to show subtle changes of framing, lighting, subject, and selection over a sequence.
limitations: Retrospective account around one celebrated photograph; contact-sheet lessons must be translated into testable selection criteria.

title: Susan Meiselas on Imagination and Photographic Education
evidence_scope: First-party discussion of Meiselas's photographic education books and project prompts spanning gesture, light, portrait disguise, imagined landscape, and collage.
limitations: Projects are prompts for exploration, not evidence that one visual solution is universally superior.

title: The Coast
evidence_scope: First-party discussion of a long-term Indian project and how photographs, moving image, text, and book form create multiple readings.
limitations: Project-specific practice; not a general recipe for sequencing or representing violence.

title: Carolyn Drake Explores Atlanta through the Lens of James Baldwin
author_org: Magnum Photos / Carolyn Drake / High Museum of Art
evidence_scope: First-party work-in-progress interview on researching place and using literature while developing a long-term photo-based project.
limitations: Development process is unfinished and context-specific; literary reference is not a substitute for visible photographic structure.

title: One Influential Image: David Hurn
evidence_scope: First-person account of one influential photograph and its place in a photo essay, useful for separating method influence from surface imitation.
limitations: Autobiographical influence is not an objective quality standard.

title: Dawoud Bey on Photographing People and Communities: Learning Guide
evidence_scope: Official guide page identifies thematic lessons and image-specific questions drawn from Bey's text on photographing people and communities.
limitations: The direct curriculum document timed out during review; verify its full contents before citing a specific exercise or claim.

title: Mary Ellen Mark on the Portrait and the Moment: Learning Guide
evidence_scope: Official guide page confirms a teaching resource focused on portraiture and the moment; Aperture's On Sight curriculum cites its sections on control and forming a relationship.
limitations: Direct guide retrieval timed out during review; verify full guide and exact image references before using it in a pattern.

title: Alex Webb and Rebecca Norris Webb on Street Photography and the Poetic Image: Learning Guide
author_org: Aperture / Alex Webb / Rebecca Norris Webb
evidence_scope: Official page identifies a thematic learning guide on street photography and poetic images.
limitations: Direct page retrieval timed out and the official URL contains a likely slug typo; verify curriculum and exact passages before rule admission.

title: Black Is Beautiful: The Photography of Kwame Brathwaite — Learning Guide
evidence_scope: Official learning-guide page frames a resource for discussing the Black Is Beautiful exhibition and book across ages.
limitations: The page verifies resource scope but not every underlying aesthetic or historical claim; inspect the linked curriculum for specifics.

title: Aperture 240, Native America: Learning Guide
evidence_scope: Official educator resource provides themes, analysis of selected works, and contextual material around Native American photographic representation.
limitations: Issue-specific material; use named contributors and exact works rather than flattening diverse practices into one convention.

title: The True America: Photographs by Ernest Cole — Learning Guide
evidence_scope: Official learning-guide page identifies an educator resource accompanying Ernest Cole's exhibition and book.
limitations: The linked curriculum was not fully inspected; verify exact works, captions, and lesson content before pattern admission.
